summary: Review AI hiring and people analytics with fairness metrics and human oversight. Explore the practical five-day course.
lede: Inclusive AI governance in HR helps HR leaders, DEI officers and people analytics teams review algorithm-supported hiring and workforce decisions. Using spreadsheet exercises with synthetic workforce data, participants map decision pathways, check data representation, interpret fairness measures such as demographic parity and equal opportunity, document limitations, and design human-review and escalation controls.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who influence, review or govern AI-supported people decisions. It is designed for HR and DEI practitioners who need to connect fairness commitments with operational controls, data evidence and human review.
modules: NIST AI RMF for HR Decisions
prerequisites: Working knowledge of HR processes, DEI practice, people analytics or HR technology is recommended. No coding or prior machine-learning experience is required. Bring a laptop with access to Excel or a compatible spreadsheet application.
